The six EI buttons, close control, and scrollbar cannot be accepted from this resource root.

observations.template_commands: NOT SENT: @拒绝, !, !!, !~, @拒绝私聊, and @拒绝行会聊天 were not entered.

static_cross_check.method: independent read-only zlsdk header inspection of GameInter.Zl; no EI conclusion is inferred from these normal-ZL values
static_cross_check.expected_ei_static_reference: chat-window-render-evidence.json and chat-scrollbar-verification-evidence.json remain the primary-static EI reference for F350, six 36x34 buttons, and the 16x502 track.

verdict: Input focus and safe plain-chat send are runtime-verified in Zircon. F350 visual controls and scrolling remain blocked by unavailable EI WIL/WIX resources; normal GameInter.Zl is explicitly insufficient evidence.
